notes:
# FC-2C independent reading

Only supplied packet evidence was used. Unrotated image size 3213 x 4508. Upper y=0..6000 psf; lower y=-100..100 thousandths. Displacement labels 0,50,100,150,200,250; calibration excludes the outer right legend frame. All fitted grid lines were detected; none is predicted. Eye checks at three labels per axis agree closely with the fitted grid positions. RMS and maximum residuals are below 0.5% of axis span.

Legend identities: asterisk=4400; x=3660; square has printed stress 2935; triangle-up=2200; hollow circle=1468; solid filled circle=734. The evidence packet names the square series n2995 and gives stress 2995. As explicitly instructed, that series ID is retained in all CSVs, but the page actually prints 2935, clearly visible in legend-detail.png. No outside reading or earlier report reading was consulted to reconcile it. The unit-weight legend header is printed tau (PCF), not gamma.

Upper curves stop at different displacements: approximately 170 (4400), 161 (3660), 150 (square), 133 (2200), 79 (1468) and 67 (734) thousandths; there is no extrapolation to x=250. The initial hollow circle touches the left frame. The upper n2200 triangles near u=1223,1283,1346 lie below the author line, and its last triangle is above the line; separate marker and trace rows retain that difference. The square and x markers near vertical grids have broader bounds. Two template placements that landed on grid/author ink were rejected and restored from the labeled crops. No loop is visible.

The lower panel symbols are small and closely stacked. There are clear early squares near (704,3226) and (737,3212); neither is attributed to an origin marker of another series. The small n734 solid dots near (805,3208),(863,3196),(1042,3148) are retained. The hollow circle near (894,3198) is clearly distinct from the neighboring square at (920,3200). Circle/square/triangle/x stacks near 50,60,70,90 and 100 thousandths share ink. Assigned overlapping symbols carry 6..8-pixel bounds and notes. Late triangles and x symbols also touch. No lower-panel connecting traces are drawn.

Omitted / not independently recoverable: n4400 asterisks approximately x=50..70 near (984..1100,3230..3240); n3660 x symbols approximately x=50..70 near (984..1100,3225..3230), and possible earlier x/star symbols near x=20..40 in the triangle/zero-line stacks; a possible n1468 hollow circle near x=20 at (805,3216); a possible n734 filled circle near x=50 at (984,3184), inseparable from hollow circle/grid ink. The shapes near (1334,3187),(1392,3178),(1452,3165) cannot be established as additional square markers independently of the triangles and x symbols; these are omitted from n2995 rather than assumed. These omissions are explicit uncertainty, not claims that the tests lack those measurements.
